title: Subtree Inversion Sum II
summary: Inputs: edges as undirected endpoint pairs, nums as node values, and k. Root the tree at 0. Choose a subset of nodes; each selected node negates every value in its subtree, including itself. Distances between EVERY pair of selected nodes must be at least k edges, including pairs in separate branches. Nested inversions compose, so a value can be negated twice. Return the largest final sum.
